cess" means the customs duty imposed by sec tion 3.

annas] per maund in the case of refuse lac, or at such (Subs. by the Lac Cess (Amdt) Act, 1950 (20 of 1950), for

6. Application of the lac cess‑(1) At the close of each month or as soon thereafter as may be
convenient, the Collector shall pay the proceeds of the lac cess, after
deducting the expenses of collection (if any), to the Committee.
[(1A) The
proceeds of the cess recovered after the fifteenth day of August 1947, after
deducting expenses, of collection if any, shall be paid to the Committee
forthwith.]( Sub‑section (1A) ins. by Act 20 of
1950. s. 8.)
[(2) The
Committee shall adopt such measures as it may consider necessary or expedient
for the improvement and develop ment of methods of cultivating, manufacturing
and marketing lac.]( Subs. ibid., for sub‑section
(2).)
